name: Mr. Rescue
author: Tangram Games (Simon Larsen)
description: A fireman with a water cannon fights his way up burning buildings, throws the people he rescues out of the windows and faces the arsonist bosses. On-screen d-pad, Jump, Water, Grab. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

descriptions.en: A fireman with a water cannon fights his way up burning buildings, throws the people he rescues out of the windows and faces the arsonist bosses. On-screen d-pad, Jump, Water, Grab. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.
descriptions.it: Un pompiere con l'idrante risale palazzi in fiamme, lancia dalle finestre le persone che salva e affronta i piromani. Croce direzionale, Salto, Acqua, Prendi sullo schermo. Un gioco LÖVE sul motore Lua App.
